title: SCNet P0 R06g 800 m/s no-mass-scaling TSSFAC refinement
purpose: Determine whether the TSSFAC=0.4 no-confirmed-crossing response is stable under a second factor-two refinement to TSSFAC=0.2 while DT2MS remains zero.

provenance.identity_rule: Mesh, coordinates, connectivity, IDs, PIDs, material, EOS, contact, section, boundary conditions, speed, termination, output cards, resource contract and every CONTROL_TIMESTEP field except TSSFAC remain identical to the released Job 72630855 deck.

symmetry.validity: normal incidence, face-on cube, centered impact only

shared_measurement_upgrade.database_extent_binary_policy: Set NEIPH=6 and explicitly preserve all other R15.0.2 documented Card 1/Card 2 defaults; Card 2 is mandatory.

damage_source.sentinel_policy: absolute value at or above 1e29 is unavailable with a reason, never zero

shared_measurement_upgrade.database_extent_d3part_policy: Explicit NEIPH=6 request is a redundant-channel experiment; full D3PLOT HVAR6 remains authoritative.

paired_experiments.question: Does a second factor-two TSSFAC reduction from 0.4 to 0.2 preserve the 800 m/s no-confirmed-crossing diagnostic response?

preregistered_evaluation.primary_comparison: r06g_0800_tssfac02 versus platform Job 72630855 using no-crossing-aware convergence gates
preregistered_evaluation.support_condition: Target R15.0.2 parses and terminates normally at one node/32 ranks; required outputs pass; qM/qP/qE absolute differences are each <=0.01; deleted-upstream mass-fraction difference is <=0.01; and qV is either within 5% when available in both runs or not applicable because both runs have zero confirmed crossing mass.
preregistered_evaluation.refute_condition: Parser/runtime/resource failure, missing required output, mass scaling, nonfinite evidence, response/deleted-mass disagreement, or asymmetric qV availability.
preregistered_evaluation.secondary_diagnostics: Energy, negative-volume topology, alive masks, HVAR6 and NCFORC are reported as mechanism evidence and do not replace the primary gates.
preregistered_evaluation.claim_boundary: Agreement would support a local timestep-convergence decision for this single 800 m/s case only, not material truth or dataset admission.

submission_sequence.wave_0_gate: Zero KEY errors, 1 node/32 ranks, normal termination, no mass scaling, run-integrity PASS, readable D3PART/full-D3PLOT HVAR6/NCFORC, and the preregistered no-crossing-aware comparison against Job 72630855.
submission_sequence.hold_after_wave_0: Do not submit 2000 m/s or any treatment until the returned TSSFAC=0.2 refinement is audited and the timestep strategy is explicitly selected.
submission_sequence.resource_identity: Use exactly one node, 32 ranks, LS-DYNA R15 MPP double precision, and the same memory settings as Job 72630855.

deferred_not_generated.reason: Hold until the TSSFAC=0.2 convergence diagnostic is audited.

claim_boundary: Job 72630855 ran successfully but failed the frozen 0.8-versus-0.4 timestep-sensitivity gate.
This package changes only TSSFAC from 0.4 to 0.2 and keeps DT2MS=0.
A null qV is not zero and is only a convergence non-applicable case when both runs have zero confirmed crossing mass.
Static PASS and normal termination do not establish timestep convergence, physical validity, P0/P1 admission, engine fitting, or dataset-label admission.
